high_severity_items.summary: IMF warns of a potential disorderly spike in sovereign bond yields, driven by resurgent inflation, elevated public debt and rollover risk, higher energy costs tied to the Middle East conflict, tighter monetary expectations, and a growing wave of AI-related debt issuance that competes with government bonds for investor capital. The report also flags hedge fund leverage and crowded Treasury basis trades as amplification channels, plus circular financing among AI firms as a concentrated vulnerability.
high_severity_items.title: IMF warns bond yields could see a 'disorderly' spike as debt, inflation risks worsen

high_severity_items.summary: IMF's latest outlook shows a milder global slowdown than feared, with AI-driven investment offsetting part of the energy supply shock from the Middle East war, but flags that resilience is nearing its limits. Inflation forecasts were revised up, energy reserves are being drawn down, fiscal positions are deteriorating and advanced-economy yields sit at multidecade highs, with growth increasingly reallocated toward AI-linked economies and away from energy importers.
high_severity_items.title: IMF sees milder global slowdown as AI boom offsets war hit — warns resilience is nearing limits

high_severity_items.summary: Rising mortgage rates and expectations of further Fed tightening are suppressing refinance and total origination volumes, while non-QM lending and ARM usage expand as product mix shifts away from conforming loans. high_severity_items.title: Optimal Blue data shows non-QM lending, ARM usage is expanding

high_severity_items.summary: Prolonged LNG supply disruption from the Middle East after the Iran war has removed roughly a fifth of global seaborne LNG from the market, with Qatar barely shipping and the Strait of Hormuz constrained. The shock tightens global gas balances, lifts energy costs, and reinforces geopolitical and inflation pressures, with differentiated effects across energy, utilities, and energy-intensive sectors.
high_severity_items.title: Stranded Middle East LNG Supply Upends Gas Markets
